source: Iced-Cream's own tests on their unit: the R8T2 run of the port's test steps and the C3A4 unit test; and the SXH4 bench runs on the same unit (2026-10-24 and 2026-10-25); and the solo bench run of MRH4 on the same unit (2026-10-25)
statement: Hardware, OS 1.74: in R8T2 (2026-10-18) main-rms's test passes: with the FX track's AMP page open, a loud pattern inverts the VOL label, and it clears when the output gets quieter. In C3A4 (core-ar2 0.3 and all eleven rytm2_mods v1.2 ports, 2026-10-20) each mod's own test passed, including this one's. On SXH4 (released core-ar2 0.3 with the other five Modwerk 1.74 submissions, 2026-10-24/25) VOL stayed plain while the main output stayed below the threshold, and with the main output at -3.4 dBFS RMS VOL inverted while playing and cleared about 4 s after STOP. Alone on MRH4 (released core-ar2 0.3 and this module only, 2026-10-25) VOL inverted with the main output above the threshold and cleared within 4.4 s of stop.
scope: main-rms 1.0 beside other rytm2_mods ports. SXH4 ran it with the released core-ar2 0.3 and the other five Modwerk 1.74 submissions. MRH4 ran it alone with the released core-ar2 0.3.

builds.label: MRH4
builds.content: The released core-ar2 0.3 and this module's rytm2_mods v1.2 release object as the only module, plus the remote-control test layer (analoghealth 1.2, no site shared with core or the module). Driven over USB by a scripted bench in a ~T test project; outputs recorded over USB audio; stock 1.74 restored after the run.
results: Alone: with the main output at -3.4 dBFS RMS VOL was inverted while playing and plain again 4.4 s after stop.
No freeze or dropout on any output.

builds.label: SXH4
builds.content: The released core-ar2 0.3 and rytm2_mods v1.2's release objects for the six Modwerk 1.74 submissions, plus a remote-control test layer (three sites, none shared with core or the modules). Without the test layer the same inputs give SX74 (2a352718de044cdba51a2b8a3a064ef126d79ab54f24ac7a7662f6c686e64371). Driven over USB by a scripted bench in a ~T test project; outputs recorded over USB audio; stock 1.74 restored after each run.
results: SXH4: VOL stayed plain with the main output at most -26.5 dBFS RMS (no false trigger); with the main output at -3.4 dBFS RMS it inverted in all six shots while playing and was plain again 4.4 s after STOP.

Four minutes of play with samples, delay and reverb sends and knob turns: no freeze, gap or level dip on any output; clicks on the main mix also appear on the same core and test layer without the modules.

builds.label: C3A4
builds.content: core-ar2 0.3 as built before elekloader #153, and rytm2_mods v1.2's eleven OS 1.74 release objects. Relinking those files on stock 1.74 gives this main OS byte for byte.
results: Each mod's own test passed, including Main RMS's.

builds.label: R8T2
builds.content: core-ar2 0.1 ported to 1.74 with filter-hz, ctrl-all 1.1, env-reset-amp, slice-loop, main-rms, lfo-rnd, comp-preview and kit-ab. main-rms's OS 1.74 source is the same file as in v1.2.
results: Step 9: on the FX track's AMP page a loud pattern inverts the VOL label; it clears when the output gets quieter.

individualTestResults: VOL label inverts while the output is loud
Label clears when the output gets quieter
SXH4: no false trigger below the threshold; inverts at -3.4 dBFS RMS and clears after stop
SXH4: four-minute play, no freeze or dropout
Alone (MRH4): VOL inverts above the threshold and clears after stop

contextNote: Main OS hashes are the builds', not read back from the device. SXH4 links the released core-ar2 0.3 (6b97dfb3…, with #153) that Modwerk links; C3A4's core was built before #153.
